description: FREE sample, no account: the first page (up to 20) of ONE Google Maps search for a kind of business in a place, with phones partly hidden. Nothing is saved or enriched, and it returns no emails, contacts or software. Use it only when the user asks for a preview or a sample, or has no account connected and wants to see what comes back. When the user asks to search, find, pull or list businesses, use search_leads (one city, answered at once) or search_areas (whole cities) instead, even for a single page: they save the businesses to the user's account and enrich them, and calling one starts sign-in if the account isn't connected yet. Places look like "Houston, TX", "Copenhagen" or "Lyon, France"; a shared name picks the largest and lists the others.

country.description: Optional country name, if the place name alone is ambiguous across countries

place.description: City or town, optionally with state and country, e.g. "Houston, TX" or "Aarhus, Denmark"

query.description: Kind of business, e.g. "roofing contractor" or "hair salon"

name: preview_search
title: Free sample, nothing saved
